authority: V3-N0 administrative record §9 residual R4, constraint (c)
note: One grandfathered document remains (round CONTRACT-V4 retired the contract entry, below):
the v3 plan, blob-keyed from the caller's tree this harness was extracted from — the
in-tree copy under document-harness/plans/ is a different blob, and nothing scans it.
It permanently carries a self-referential approval field in
its own frontmatter and can never be brought into compliance, because the rules that
forbid editing them are the same rules the check exists to protect. Without an enumerated
exemption the R4 check could never go green against the repository's own constitution,
and the only alternatives would be to relax a correct check or to hide an undocumented
exception inside the checker. Both are forbidden.
The list is keyed on the exact Git blob, never on a path or a glob. That is what makes it
fail closed: edit one byte and the blob changes, the exemption stops matching, and the
document is flagged again. A path-keyed exemption would silently keep covering whatever
that path later became.
Each entry grandfathers ONLY the fields listed. A blob that later turns out to carry an
additional self-approval field is reported as V3-GOVERNANCE-EXEMPTION-NARROWER rather
than passing.
The correct delegating pattern is NOT exempted and does not need to be: fields whose name
ends in '_owner' (approval_status_owner, signature_owner) name who owns the approval state
without carrying it, and pass the check on their own merit.
Adding an entry here requires a user decision. This register is not a place to silence a
finding about a document that could have been written correctly.

exemptions.immutability_rule: Plan §0 binds user approval to this exact Git blob (SHA-256 9B08CD0038FA0C36E76674B7CE386129D9797EFFE5CEC7FABBF69699811F171F) and §13 states the approved plan bytes remain unchanged; §11 forbids amending approved governance bytes in place. Editing the frontmatter would break the approval binding recorded at V3-N0 §1.

retired.why: The v3 contract left the tree when contract v4 (which carries no self-approval field) superseded it as the operative text; a blob no longer in the tree meets no scan, so the entry grandfathers nothing. Kept here as a retired record rather than deleted silently: the register's own note reserves adding an entry to a user decision, and removal follows the same authority — the removing decision is round CONTRACT-V4's signature entry in HARNESS-DECISIONS.md, owed at the signing checkpoint and not yet written.
